content: React Router v7 is the safer, higher-adoption default for most teams in 2026 (biggest ecosystem, least migration friction). TanStack Router offers stronger end-to-end type safety but has a steeper learning curve and smaller ecosystem; better fit for client-heavy SPAs/dashboards with aggressive TypeScript needs. For a small multi-page static-data site, React Router v7 (declarative/data mode, no SSR needed) is sufficient and lower-risk.
